Subject: Request: GPU availability + provisional capacity hold for Akari Health (late-stage)

Team —

Akari Health (head of ML: Sasha) is in late-stage procurement for a Dedicated deployment. The commercial team requests we verify fleet availability and, if possible, place a provisional capacity hold while legal and procurement finish contracting. Key asks below:

- Customer: Akari Health (related account in HubSpot)
- Deal: RWI-2026-DEAL-78 — expected go-live window: 2026-04-01 to 2026-07-01 (initial)
- Requested dedicated capacity: 4x A100 80GB (or equivalent) persistent nodes in us-west1; burstable to 6x during onboarding (first 3 weeks)
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~120 requests/minute across two replicas; model: 70B decoder-only, KV cache heavy, average context 2k tokens
- Business ask: 21-day provisional hold on the requested capacity (soft hold) while DocuSign is routed; hold should be cancellable if not executed.

Attached: akari_sow_v1.pdf, akari_req_matrix.xlsx (SOW includes timeline).

Please reply with current inventory, any constraints (maintenance windows, existing reservations), and whether infra can place a 21-day provisional hold tied to DEAL-78. If a full hold isn't possible, give the recommended alternative (e.g., token-based reservation or capacity tokens).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Request: GPU availability + provisional capacity hold for Akari Health (late-stage)

Marissa —

Inventory snapshot (as of 2026-02-23 08:50 PT):
- us-west1: 6 free A100 80GB nodes (uncommitted), 10 A10G nodes; 2 nodes currently in maintenance window next week (planned reboot 2026-02-26).
- us-east1: limited — 1 free A100 80GB, recommend not using for primary customer placement.

Constraints / notes:
- We can create a "provisional allocation" (soft hold) for up to 21 days that prevents new general allocations but is overridable by emergencies and higher-priority enterprise commits. This is not a billing reservation — it's a scheduling/placement flag in the autoscaler.
- To make the hold meaningful for the customer we should: 1) pin region (us-west1), 2) pin GPU type (A100 80GB), 3) record earliest start date.
- We cannot enforce physical isolation without a Dedicated contract (Dedicated capacity contract required for full isolation).

Operational suggestion:
- Create provisional allocation now for 4x A100 80GB from 2026-04-01 with burst to 6x through 2026-04-21. Expiry: 21 days after creation unless move to a committed reservation.
- Tie the hold to deal id RWI-2026-DEAL-78 and a soft-priority tag so SRE knows this is customer conversion-critical.

Action items I can take if you confirm:
1) Create the provisional allocation and post the hold ID here.
2) Block the calendars for planned maintenance windows around the onboarding period (avoid 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-10 if possible).
3) Provide an exact ETA for when a committed reservation (billing/reserved capacity) would be required to guarantee allocation post-hold.

I'll wait for a final confirmation from sales to create the allocation.

— Vivek

Subject: Re: Request: GPU availability + provisional capacity hold for Akari Health (late-stage)

Quick performance notes from SE perspective —

Assumptions from their SOW: 70B model, heavy KV-cache, average 2k context. If we target A100 80GB:
- 4x A100 80GB (2 replicas) should meet latency targets for the stated QPS; onboarding burst to 6x covers eval load.
- Cost alternative: 8x A10G (quantized model and kernel tweaks) could match throughput at lower unit cost but increases engineering lift for quantization and we must validate CQA.

Risk/ask: If we make a soft hold and Akari delays signing beyond 21 days, there's a risk we lose the A100 capacity to another customer with a committed reservation. Recommend we:
1) Ask legal to push for an initial 3-month reserved commitment (or refundable deposit) as part of the term sheet if they need longer to sign.
2) Offer a short-term committed burst (billing-backed) for onboarding weeks if Akari is willing to accept a short billing commitment.

If you want, I can run a quick cost/e2e perf sim against both A100 and A10G profiles and post the recommendation by EOD.

— Connor
